events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect T-252 card, patches, README, push state

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read README section and re-apply patches on scratch copy
events.input: $ sed -n 60,76p workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md | cut -c1-220; ls -d ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && git -C ~/tantra-frontend-v2 rev-parse --short adi-new-ui; S=$(mktemp -d); git -C ~/tantra-frontend-v2 archive adi-new-ui | tar -x -C $S && cd $S && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=v -c user.email=v@x commit -qm base && P=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-frontend-v2; for f in adi-new-ui--0d737b3509 adi-new-ui--5d6eecf642 [redacted] [redacted]; do git -c user.name=v -c user.e

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run vitest on patched scratch tree
events.input: $ S=/var/folders/0q/rvn_cgb93fd2y3vhzb6phcsc0000gn/T/tmp.zDJM7fQh6P; ls -d ~/tantra-frontend-v2/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && ln -s ~/tantra-frontend-v2/node_modules $S/node_modules; cd $S && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' | head

events.text: Now the voice probe on the patched tree.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server on scratch tree and run voice probe
events.input: $ S=/var/folders/0q/rvn_cgb93fd2y3vhzb6phcsc0000gn/T/tmp.zDJM7fQh6P; cd $S && lsof -ti:4347 >/dev/null && echo PORT_BUSY; (npx next dev -p 4347 > /tmp/t252-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4347/pricing 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'pricing %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:4347/pricing; node scripts/probe-voice-pages.mjs http://localhost:4347 2>&1 | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Filter voice probe failures excluding PostHog warning
events.input: $ S=/var/folders/0q/rvn_cgb93fd2y3vhzb6phcsc0000gn/T/tmp.zDJM7fQh6P; cd $S && node scripts/probe-voice-pages.mjs http://localhost:4347 > /tmp/t252-voice.txt 2>&1; grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/t252-voice.txt; grep '^FAIL' /tmp/t252-voice.txt | grep -v 'POSTHOG' | head -5; grep '^FAIL' /tmp/t252-voice.txt | awk '{print $3}' | sort -u | wc -l
